references.text: God describes how he carried Israel on eagle's wings out of Egypt, the same image of God carrying his people
Moses' song describes how God found Israel in the wilderness and carried them as an eagle carries its young
Moses complains about the burden of carrying the people, like a father carries his child - the same metaphor of carrying
Isaiah describes how God carried and lifted up his people in days of old
God promises to carry Israel from the womb to old age, the same theme of God's care as one who carries
Hosea describes God's fatherly love for Israel as children, and how he taught them to walk
Paul refers to how God bore with Israel's conduct in the wilderness for forty years
The same context in Deuteronomy about God's guidance through the wilderness and his fatherly discipline
